notes.title: September 18th, 2025 Patch Notes
notes.content: [p]Sound the trumpets, bang the drums, hang the party banners and get on your finest attire, for a mid-season Balance Patch is upon us! Let’s dig right into these delectable morsels and see what all the changes this patch has to offer.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]Card Changes[/h2][p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560184/322d8a00c1e2ed41ec5aa2b1ed1e61e2596fee54.png"][/img][/p][h3]Hannibal[/h3][p align="start"]Since Hannibal was introduced at the beginning of the month on the premium Galaxy Pass, he has outperformed our expectations and the results of every other captain. We are tweaking his countdown from 6 animals KO’d to 7 in an effort to bring him better into parity with our other captains. Not a major change so we expect him to still be a strong captain, but will no longer be so far ahead.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]Card Reworks[/h3][p]Loki[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560184/0dae4c187858c6ad0a2de71a44c148296bbc13ea.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"]This is partly a quality of life upgrade, your spells will do more of what you expect. And a pretty big power up, so we will keep an eye on how he performs.[/p][hr][/hr][p]Mirror Mirror[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560184/b0fcd8f2194eeeecc4fc8be553e58e57ce852b0c.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h3]Major Changes[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560184/59c0b3f5f846cb4851802a88230367cf38c76349.png"][/img][/p][p]Parting Gift now only doubles farewells in your front row. (We expect this to still be one of the strongest Epic treasures)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560184/c00adf9ea72de8dd22e432edf06ee0dfa14b7273.png"][/img][/p][p]Shrink Tea now targets the enemy with the highest attack. We considered renaming it to “Herc B-Gone!” but leaving it as Shrink Tea for now.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560184/785051065ca144f16465257a8609a19ec7aedbec.png"][/img][/p][p]Weird Beard has been reverted back to only giving treasures based on Goldened Pirates instead of Silver. (Was in just too many of the top performing decklists)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560184/cbb47aef478407647a9115c712dd6e2b06b11d76.png"][/img][/p][p]Morgan Le Fae getting a bit of a power up, should be impactful with spell themes prevalent with Candylar (our first expansion coming in October)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560184/9b620c4586e5163e7e183955ae499da6bc281cb2.png"][/img][/p][p]Shanty getting a pretty meaningful powerup. We didn’t want her to have to combine with Wink or the Pans to make an impact.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560184/97ea70ba52b7aeb2d8dddbcbf56e151843b0c0bf.png"][/img][/p][p]Dragon Dice getting a nerf should leave it in a strong spot for increasing Treasure Hoard while not giving the late game powerful common treasures, as often. It also means Dragon Dice treasures will not eat Lesser Mimic copies which was a common downside before.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]Minor Changes[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560184/1df6e7e5e9a55f781e0950eee1b6f053aa1cdb10.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Jack Sparrow has been renamed to Jay Sparrow[/p][/*][*][p]Excalibur and KO Star now keep buff during fight (mostly a bug fix)[/p][/*][*][p]Happily Ever After and All for One will now wait until the next shop before Buffing (this change in timing doesn’t change how the cards functioned before but does make it clearer the buff is being applied)[/p][/*][*][p]Zagreus now waits until the next shop to determine the rarity of treasure given and now works with Smug[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Charon’s upgrading buff not working correctly on a non-full board has been fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Mid-Battle “start turn” button has been fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Leaderboard and navbar should no longer overlap[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]Quality of Life Change[/h2][p align="start"]Buffs like the hunt abilities of Hercules and Big Bad Wolf will now trigger [b]before[/b] effects like Poison Apple. The result of this change should be that Herc and Big Bad Wolf end up at 1 health rather than them being set to 1 hp and then buffing up again. We are making this change in order to allow effects like Poison Apple to be better counters to large stated lads.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]Candylar: The Sweet Set - Meet the New Captain[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560184/81b4d4317f329915a5583f5788bf0b5943f547c2.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Coming to a Galaxy near you this October![/p][hr][/hr][p align="start"]Well that is a lot of changes! Come sound off in the Discord and the [url="https://reddit.com/r/onceuponagalaxy"]Subreddit[/url] to let us know what you think of these changes and also stay tuned to our [url="https://twitter.com/playgalaxygame"]Twitter[/url], [url="https://bsky.app/profile/playgalaxygame.bsky.social"]Bluesky[/url] and [url="https://instagram.com/playgalaxygame"]Instagram[/url] and your favorite Once Upon a Galaxy content creators for Candylar spoilers over the next several weeks![/p][p align="start"]‘Til next time, see you in the stars.[/p]

notes.title: New Season: Hannibal
notes.content:
[p] NEW Galaxy Pass for September! Let's meet our new Captain and check out the sweet alt arts![img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560184/fecbdab335bb2877a1d73a85f01c9a3d4e3e57bf.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h2]Premium Rewards[/h2][h3][i](Level 1) [/i]New Captain: [b]Hannibal[/b]![/h3][p align="start"]The rocks shake as he treads across the mountains. Pebbles turn into a rockslide beneath the stampede of animals in his wake. Lift your trunks, for Hannibal has arrived on the Premium Galaxy Pass September 1st![/p][p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560184/322d8a00c1e2ed41ec5aa2b1ed1e61e2596fee54.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"][i]After 6 of your Animals are KO’d give each of your slots +1/+1. Then improve this ability by +1/+1.[/i][/p][hr][/hr][h3][i](Level 30) [/i][b]Singing in the Snow[/b] alternate art![/h3][p align="start"]
Stage lights are on, snow is falling and Mr. Lamppost’s dance number is on full blast! Time to be the star of the show with the [i]‘Singing in the Snow’[/i] alternate art for Mr. Lamppost, available at level 30 of the September Premium Galaxy Pass.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560184/6d8ece38003b19faaeb8b11c2f091ef80bbda2f9.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h3][i](Level 50) [/i][b]Pool Party Hannibal [/b]alternate art![/h3][p align="start"]Summer may be winding to a close but there is still time for one last pool party! Splash down with Pool Party Hannibal at level 50 of the September Premium Galaxy Pass![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560184/370ead5e9b2acb417494833704e2bc5bd3e80617.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h3][i](Level 1) [/i]This Month’s Free Galaxy Pass Captain: [b]Zagreus[/b]![/h3][p align="start"]Zagreus is tired of waiting! It’s his turn on the Free Galaxy Pass! On September 1st, watch as he unlocks for all players to showcase how losing a fight can be the best thing that could have happened for your run![/p][p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560184/7b112984dfc496563184baf11253dd27db2899db.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h3][i](Level 40) [/i][b]Lightburglar [/b]alternate art![/h3][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Once a thief, always a thief. Zeus is bringing down the punishment in this shocking new alt art [i]‘Lightburglar’[/i] for Lightning Thief. Available for free at level 40 of the September Free Galaxy Pass![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560184/2c78abfac888056bb018130be22915cb6d292737.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p] That's all for now! May your Animals be plentiful, may your pool parties rock and may your bottle be ever full of Pumpkin Spice Latte.[/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes: August 28th, 2025
notes.content: [h2]In-Game Store[/h2][p align="start"]With September rolling in, we’ve got to say goodbye to some amazing skins in the store. Leonardo di Skippi, Wicked Vengeance Hades and Princess Miyazaki will be leaving the In-Game Store on September 1st. Pick them up before they leave![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560184/04546b4a68ea552f639f9701f45ccd4903569d30.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Maximus harnesses the power of the cosmos in this amazing new [i]‘Lightning Tiger Hoo’[/i] skin![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560184/914b27662902feb2cec37f116121d80844541da3.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Some fan favorite skins are making their return to the shop this month, [i]‘You Shall Not Pass’[/i] and [i]‘Big Bad Piggie’[/i] ![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560184/b9902c00f3b62ccdb92d63500a0828938bcd4f1f.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h2]Bug Fixes and Other Changes[/h2][p][/p][list][*][p]Improved optimization to allow for complex late-game scenarios better and abort complex battles less often.[/p][/*][*][p]In Async mode, when the game abandons a complex fight mid-combat (like when you have a lot of hunt triggers), we now count it as a battle win for the active player. This will allow games to reach a conclusion.[/p][/*][*][p]When viewing the locked Galaxy Pass captain during Captain Select, you can now see and zoom in on the Captain to read their abilities.[/p][/*][*][p]Type Tags now show in shop while playing Chief Evil Officer (Villains), King Arthur (Heroes), Boy Who Cried Werewolf (Animal) and Hannibal (Animal).[/p][/*][*][p]Type tags will be hidden during battle and fix visual bugs when switching between multiple tags each action during shop phase.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Jack Sparrow Bug Fix[/h3][p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560184/bd7c7e19482b63730ada79a900d5093414bd26c4.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"]We are also fixing an inconsistency we found with Jack Sparrow where it would sometimes be +1 additional hunt trigger and other times it would be 2x hunt triggers.[/p][p align="start"]Generally, we lean towards +1 additional trigger when we use the term “Double” and this is how Hunter’s Horn works. We have fixed these inconsistencies by making Jack always be +1 additional hunt trigger.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2]Candylar: The Sweet Set[/h2][p]Here is a little bonus sneak peak of the first Galaxy expansion filled with tons of new cards and fun.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560184/93d08141cf72141b3b7e9e743017161523632265.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560184/70b8c95a7bc09944ecd1959330b78e3b37b5ca4d.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Candylar: The Sweet Set drops on all platforms in October![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p align="start"]That's all for now! May your Animals be plentiful, may your pool parties rock and may your bottle be ever full of Pumpkin Spice Latte.[/p][p align="start"]Come let us know what you think of the patch changes in the [url="https://discord.gg/p7cuZQrmdX"]Discord[/url], on [url="https://x.com/PlayGalaxyGame"]Twitter[/url], [url="https://bsky.app/profile/playgalaxygame.bsky.social"]Bluesky[/url], [url="https://reddit.com/r/PlayGalaxy"]Reddit[/url] and [url="https://instagram.com/playgalaxygame"]Instagram[/url] or come join our weekly Dev [url="https://twitch.com/playgalaxygame"]Twitch[/url] Streams on Tuesdays at 2pm EST.[/p][p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560184/69a4cfe9ef048ddca32d471c5ecb9e1066c8bb4b.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"]We would also love to hear your thoughts in a review on [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3062740/Once_Upon_a_Galaxy/"]Steam[/url], [url="https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.MillionDreams.OnceUponAGalaxy&hl=en_US"]Android[/url] and in the [url="https://apps.apple.com/us/app/once-upon-a-galaxy/id6504776189"]Apple App Store[/url]. Leaving those reviews is a huge help to an indie company like ours and helps us make our millions of dreams come true.[/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes: August 18th, 2025
notes.content: [p align="start"]What an insane first half of August for Once Upon a Galaxy. Thousands of new players flooding in every week and y’alls reviews, comments, support and all the streams and content have been truly loved by our small team. With the fire fully stoked beneath us, we are scorching through the summer with some big big updates to come soon. For now, we’ve got some balance changes, new music and an elephant enters the room. Let’s dig in.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]Music[/h2][p][/p][p align="start"]With the Steam release, we have gotten a ton of feedback about the lack of music in the client. We have a lot of grand plans and ideas for Music and SFX that will take time to get fully commissioned and implemented.[/p][p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560184/91609b281e73d64ac99db48d5da6829267946004.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"]For now, we have licensed some wonderful placeholder music from Fesliyan Studios who made the main screen music you may have heard already.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]Card Changes[/h2][p][/p][p align="start"]Overall, we are really happy with our overall balance. That said, there are always a few outliers on both ends and we are looking to bring some of those back into line.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560184/5631d9057c4d11efa12946ec9c2091fb0bd025e7.png"][/img][/p][h3]Major Changes[/h3][list][*][p]Wind Up Toy now gains +2 attack when attacked (was +1)[/p][/*][*][p]Mortakon’s Quest now needs to see 50 total stats summoned (was 30)[/p][/*][*][p]Tsarmina now buffs +4/+4 when it’s supported hunts (was +3/+3) ; Also now requires only 4 hunts for her quest (was 6)[/p][/*][*][p]Dragonmother no longer gives +5 attack on transform[/p][/*][*][p]Pisces now increases fae buffs by +3/+3 (was +2/+2)[/p][/*][*][p]Flying Monkey is now a 2/2 (was a 3/2)[/p][/*][*][p]Ninja-in-Training is no longer a Toy (was a Toy Animal Hero, now Animal Hero)[/p][/*][*][p]Combustible Dragon now has Treasure Hoard 3 (was 2)[/p][/*][*][p]Buried Treasure now gives Treasure Hoard 2 (was 3)[/p][/*][*][p]Pirate Prince now gives 1 random common treasure (was 2)[/p][/*][*][p]Weird Beard and Tiamat’s Claw can no longer give Secret Rare treasures (unless your captain is Artemis[/p][/*][/list][h3]Minor Changes[/h3][list][*][p]Earth Stone triggers at start of turn, not start of battle (text already reflected this but now the effect matches)[/p][/*][*][p]Sinbad now triggers on Midas Touch (was always the intention but it now works)[/p][/*][*][p]Greed and Dragon’s Crown now have helper text.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Ace of Hearts Golden text to reflect actual effect (it gives 2 bonus shops not 1)[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]Quality of Life Changes, Bug Fixes, Various Improvements[/h2][p][/p][list][*][p]Added a “down for maintenance” mode to limit impact of future outages[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Opponents' boards will no longer disappear after you lose a fight (this was a bug)[/p][/*][*][p]Melody’s Lute no longer triggers itself (also a bug)[/p][/*][*][p]Zeus now shows multiplier and highlights on spells when active[/p][/*][*][p]Added Music and Sound volume sliders[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where you’d get a blank screen while reconnecting during Captain Select of a Live Lobby[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560184/1f7f127121f12168614dadaa85f65473a9d59195.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2]Please Review Us![/h2][p align="start"]The Steam launch has been an absolute resounding success for Once Upon a Galaxy so far. For those of you who have already left a review, it has made all the difference as it tells Steam that people love our game and encourages them to show us to new players.[/p][p align="start"]Those who have not gotten around to reviewing us, please do so on all platforms you consume our game on. It goes a long way to keeping our momentum going.[/p][hr][/hr][p align="start"]Come let us know what you think of the patch changes in the [url="https://discord.gg/p7cuZQrmdX"]Discord[/url], on [url="https://x.com/PlayGalaxyGame"]Twitter[/url], [url="https://bsky.app/profile/playgalaxygame.bsky.social"]Bluesky[/url], [url="https://reddit.com/r/PlayGalaxy"]Reddit[/url] and [url="https://instagram.com/playgalaxygame"]Instagram[/url] or come join our weekly Dev [url="https://twitch.com/playgalaxygame"]Twitch[/url] Streams on Tuesdays at 2pm EST and be sure to leave us a review on [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3062740/Once_Upon_a_Galaxy/"]Steam[/url], [url="https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.MillionDreams.OnceUponAGalaxy&hl=en_US"]Android[/url] and in the [url="https://apps.apple.com/us/app/once-upon-a-galaxy/id6504776189"]Apple App Store[/url]![/p]

notes.title: Why We Choose Human Artists
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560184/4faf2a9ccc42db8142852a1fff6856510df02566.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p align="start"]At [i]Once Upon a Galaxy[/i], we believe that art is more than pixels on a screen—it’s heart, it’s story, and it’s a shared vision brought to life through human creativity.[/p][p align="start"]In an age where AI-generated images are faster and cheaper than ever, it can be tempting to automate the creative process. But we’ve made a conscious choice to stand by human artists.[/p][p align="start"]Why? Because the spark that brings our galaxy to life, all the whimsy, the emotion, the charm [i]can’t be generated[/i]. It must be [i]crafted[/i].[/p][p align="start"]And there’s no better example of that than our new favorite card art: [i]Bedtime for Barky[/i] by [b][url="https://www.artstation.com/philiera"]Ekaterina Lusupova[/url][/b].[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560184/b4da74cd68073214818886359555c31d92549002.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h2]From Dream to Drawing Board[/h2][p align="start"]When we reached out to our wonderful artist, [b]Ekaterina Lusupova[/b], we knew she’d bring something magical to the table. Here’s the prompt we sent her:[/p][quote][p][i]This is the cutest little werewolf you ever did see! It is bedtime, he has his PJs on, his nightcap and is tucked snug into bed. He is holding tight his stuffed animal sheep, who he always sleeps with. He looks sleepy but very content.[/i][/p][/quote][p align="start"]It was a short and sweet concept — just a few lines — but Ekaterina instantly understood the tone we were going for: cozy, charming, and full of character. What she delivered absolutely melted our team’s hearts.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="2GektVR9CHA;full"][/previewyoutube][hr][/hr][h2]Why It Matters[/h2][p align="start"]In a game like [i]Once Upon a Galaxy[/i], where fairy tales meet space fantasy, the tone is everything. We rely on our art not just to make things look good, but to make them feel right. Every card, every background, every silly creature or joke has a purpose and we need artists who understand that, who feel it with us.[/p][p align="start"]Supporting real artists is also a way of investing in our broader creative community. When we commission a piece, we’re not just buying art, we’re building relationships, supporting livelihoods, and making a game that we can be proud to have people play.[/p]

notes.title: Once Upon a Galaxy — Roadmap Reveal!
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone — we're excited to finally share a roadmap of what we're working on and all the incredible features coming soon to Galaxy! This is your sneak peek into what's coming up.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560184/9d0e79d86f693e7377c41a9c4bc78d830cd42162.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h2]On Deck[/h2][p][i]These are actively in development and launching #Soon™[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560184/5e1a047948fa67beb50c7f79a2de48519d63051b.png"][/img][/p][h3]Highlights[/h3][p][b]Monthly Tournaments[/b][/p][p]Compete for prizes and earn your way toward seasonal championships — and eventually, Worlds![/p][p][b]Live Lobbies (Ranked Matchmaking)[/b][/p][p]As much as we love async, we know there's nothing quite like crushing live opponents. This mode features turn timers and real-time matchmaking for players who want that head-to-head rush.[/p][p][b]Set 2 Release[/b][/p][p]Tons of exciting new cards and synergies to play with — trust us, it's sweet.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]In the Wings[/h2][p][i]Planned and scoped — but still in the oven a bit longer[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560184/bf74d22315ce3245eacbd77df767a980a175f8c3.png"][/img][/p][h3]Highlights[/h3][p][b]Audio, Music & SFX v1[/b][/p][p]Now that Steam is live, we want to give sound the love it deserves. It'll be full of personality, polish, and Galaxy soul.[/p][p][b]Upgraded VFX Pass[/b][/p][p]"You like (poison) apples? How bout dem (poison) apples!" — We've got plenty more beautiful hand-drawn VFX where that came from.[/p][p][b]Deckbuilder v2[/b][/p][p]The v1 deckbuilder did its job for alpha, but its not up to Galaxy standards. We're rebuilding it from the ground up for a smoother, smarter experience.[/p][p][b]Competitive Enhancements[/b][/p][p]Legendary players rejoice! We're exploring the best way to show detailed lobby/captain/stats info without overwhelming new players — it's all about the right balance.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]On the Horizon[/h2][p][i]These are further down the road, once we're a bit closer to full release[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560184/33d99fea4343573a350429a004feb7af18e0c971.png"][/img][/p][h3]Highlights[/h3][p][b]Quarterly New Set Releases[/b][/p][p]As we ramp up, we're aiming for a full schedule of 3–4 exciting new sets per year.[/p][p][b]"Save and Come Back" Support[/b][/p][p]We love how async works in Galaxy, but sometimes you want to switch apps or pick up a run later. It's a pretty heavy lift — but it's on the list.[/p][p][b]Achievements & Player Quests[/b][/p][p]Long-term goals, creative missions, and new ways to express mastery — we're just getting started.[/p][hr][/hr][p]We've got tons of exciting updates ahead, and we can't wait to hear what you think. Got ideas? Feedback? Bring it. And as always, we'll see you in the stars.[/p][p]—The Galaxy Dev Team[/p]

notes.title: New Season: Boy who Cried Werewolf
notes.content:
[p]The start of August means a new season and new rewards![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560184/fecbdab335bb2877a1d73a85f01c9a3d4e3e57bf.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]What is the Galaxy Pass?[/b][/h2][p]This is [i]Once Upon a Galaxy’s[/i] version of a battle pass. It gives booster cards rewards, new Captain cards and alternate-art Captain skins![/p][p][/p][p]For everyone just joining with our release on Steam, here's a quick guide to our pass system: [/p][list][*][p]There's a new season each month.[/p][/*][*][p]Games played earn season progression, from level 1 to level 50 and beyond![/p][/*][*][p]Leveling rewards bonus booster cards on the Free track. Everyone has the Free Pass automatically, just hop on and play![/p][/*][*][p]A Premium track can be purchased any time during the season for additional booster rewards. The Premium Pass costs $9.99. You unlock rewards right away for any progress you've already made (you don't restart the track from the beginning).[/p][/*][*][p]Each season features a brand-new Captain. You get the Captain at level 1 of the Premium track, and its alt-art skin at level 50! The Premium track includes another exclusive skin or other rewards.[/p][/*][*][p]Two months after its Premium debut, the Captain becomes free for everyone as the new season's level 1 reward. The Free track includes other rewards, too![/p][/*][/list][p]That's covers the basics, but if you have any questions ask in the comments! You can also find us on the [url="https://discord.gg/p7cuZQrmdX"]Discord[/url], [url="https://x.com/PlayGalaxyGame"]Twitter[/url], [url="https://bsky.app/profile/playgalaxygame.bsky.social"]Bluesky[/url], or [url="https://reddit.com/r/PlayGalaxy"]Reddit[/url].[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560184/b10906a21b157502ae6dee457ffc92db82ea9913.png"][/img][/p][p]On to the rewards for the August season![/p][hr][/hr][h2]Premium Rewards[/h2][h3][i](Level 1) [/i]New Captain: [b]Boy who Cried Werewolf[/b]![/h3][p]Part shepherd, part troublemaker, and [i]100%[/i] werewolf, this wild child is ready to shake up the galaxy![/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560184/8081f75a6971e55ab7c44305707b2fb81a8dd0c3.png"][/img][i]Recruit 3 Animals and double the Attack and Health of the next character you recruit, turning it into an animal[/i].[/p][p]Come play with him and unleash your inner beast![/p][hr][/hr][h3][i](Level 30) [/i][b]Dr. Agon MD[/b] skin[/h3][p]Doctor, doctor give me the news, I got a bad case of loving this amazing new Dr. Agon MD skin.[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560184/20b1ff92c942cdbed8c4bf47da4bbc1652814da4.png"][/img][/p][p] Unlock Dr. Agon MD at level 30 of August's Premium track.[/p][hr][/hr][h3][i](Level 50) [/i][b]Bedtime for Barky[/b] skin[/h3][p]Nothing puts a young werewolf pup to sleep like one last game of Galaxy. [/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560184/b4da74cd68073214818886359555c31d92549002.png"][/img][/p][p]Come tuck this little good boy to sleep by unlocking the Bedtime for Barky skin at level 50 of August's Premium track.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]Free Rewards[/h2][h3][i](Level 1) [/i]Free Captain: [b]Silversmith[/b][/h3][p]Silversmith joins the Free Galaxy Pass this August. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560184/0c49a54637a6d5de667bad74e005ece4527e811f.png"][/img][i]Every third Silver character you recruit discovers a treasure of its rarity.[/i][/p][p]Recruit those silvered characters and gain fantastic rewards![/p][hr][/hr][h3][i](Level 40) [/i][b]Fishbowl Midas[/b] skin[/h3][p]This fish has no fear, King Midas leads his golden animatronic army in their quest for Galactic revenge.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560184/55b858a9040b9c2247b8415477a89eb8a2c1fc8a.png"][/img]Unlock Fishbowl Midas at level 40 of the Free track in August.[/p][hr][/hr][p]Enjoy your new Captains and skins this August! As always, we'll see you in the stars.[/p]

notes.title: Once Upon a Galaxy is out now!
notes.content: [h2]Welcome to your journey into our Galaxy! [/h2][p]First-time visitor? New captains are always welcome! Feel free to dive right in, and you can find info \[in the guidebook]([url="https://galaxy.fun/learn/"]https://galaxy.fun/learn/[/url]) to help get started.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560184/88e98542a599451e72b701f1835daa983b79e0cd.png"][/img][/p][h3]The moment is upon us and we need YOUR help![/h3][p]We’d really appreciate your help leaving a review and spreading the word! Whether you’ve been with us since the beginning of the closed beta or you’ve just discovered us, we couldn’t be more excited to have such an amazing group of players providing feedback and helping us make [i]Once Upon a Galaxy[/i] the best game it can be![/p][p]If you’re enjoying your time in our little Galaxy, leaving a Steam review is one of the most powerful ways you can help our small team. Reviews don’t just boost visibility — they help new players discover the game, shape our future development, and keep this galaxy expanding.[/p][p]We read [i]every single one[/i], and your words mean more than you know. Thank You![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]Adventures are always better with friends[/h3][p]You're welcome to join our wonderful [url="https://discord.gg/p7cuZQrmdX"]Discord[/url] community! You can also find us on [url="https://x.com/PlayGalaxyGame"]Twitter[/url], [url="https://bsky.app/profile/playgalaxygame.bsky.social"]Bluesky[/url], [url="https://reddit.com/r/PlayGalaxy"]Reddit[/url] and [url="https://instagram.com/playgalaxygame"]Instagram[/url], and we have weekly [url="https://twitch.com/playgalaxygame"]Dev Twitch Streams[/url] on Tuesdays at 2pm EST![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]Boy Who Cried Werewolf, Gencon and More...[/h3][p]This Steam release comes with game updates and other news. Information on the coming Galaxy Pass with an exciting new Captain, GenCon and more are all in the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3062740/view/508461656568758432"]patch notes[/url]![/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes: July 29th, 2025
notes.content: [p]August is here and with it, one of the most pivotal moments in the life of [i]Once Upon a Galaxy[/i]. We are officially live on Steam! More information on that, the coming Galaxy Pass with an exciting new Captain, GenCon and more are all in these patch notes so let’s dive in![/p][hr][/hr][h2]The moment is upon us and we need YOUR help![/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560184/88e98542a599451e72b701f1835daa983b79e0cd.png"][/img][/p][p][i]Once Upon a Galaxy[/i] is now available on Steam and we’d really appreciate your help leaving a review and spreading the word![/p][p]Find the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3062740/view/508461656568758427"]full announcement here[/url], thank You![/p][hr][/hr][h2]Galaxy Pass[/h2][h3]Premium Galaxy Pass[/h3][p]Part shepherd, part troublemaker, and [i]100%[/i] werewolf, this wild child is ready to shake up the galaxy![/p][p][/p][p][b]Boy who Cried Werewolf[/b][/p][p][i]Recruit 3 Animals and double the Attack and Health of the next character you recruit, turning it into an animal[/i].[/p][p][/p][p]Come play with him and unleash your inner beast![/p][p]Available August 1st on the Premium Galaxy Pass.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560184/da2b4be9a3570ecf5ed27362da018226022d3f61.png"][/img][/p][p]Doctor, doctor give me the news, I got a bad case of loving this amazing new Dr Agon MD skin. Unlock Dr. Agon MD at level 30 of the August Premium Galaxy Pass.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560184/efba0b92bc098a4d8027862c222839fa56b2bd1e.png"][/img][/p][p]Nothing puts a young werewolf pup to sleep like one last game of Galaxy. Come tuck this little good boy to sleep by unlocking the Bedtime for Barky skin at level 50 of the August Premium Galaxy Pass.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560184/14e60c7827a6da03b6abdb5c75a95b9cac081695.png"][/img][/p][h3]Free Pass[/h3][p]Silversmith joins the Free Galaxy Pass this August. Recruit those silvered characters and gain fantastic rewards![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560184/2b966033f61ed8f43e30899e4fd7163b29739145.png"][/img][/p][p]This fish has no fear, King Midas leads his golden animatronic army in their quest for Galactic revenge. Unlock Fishbowl Midas at level 40 of the Free Galaxy Pass in August.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560184/7c6c84298fb3a7904ccac8de75452191e90a9f3c.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h2]Quality of Life Changes, Bug Fixes, Various Gameplay Tweaks[/h2][list][*][p]Banking is only enabled after all 5 character slots have been filled[/p][/*][*][p]Tapping/Clicking on the Bank will now bring up a tooltip[/p][/*][*][p]New Code Redemption[/p][list][*][p]We’ve implemented a new way to redeem codes in the app for various rewards! Check out your favorite streamers and content creators soon as we will be handing out codes for folks to collect in-game rewards![/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Card zoom now pauses combat again as intended[/p][/*][*][p]Reroll and Settings buttons have been updated[/p][/*][*][p]Completely new Tutorial and New Player onboarding experience[/p][/*][*][p]App not saving Sound/Music Settings has been fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Sort order for Captain select is now starter deck, bonus decks and then user decks[/p][/*][*][p]User’s custom decks will now have no deck art (this is intentional for now)[/p][/*][*][p]Shop buffs now pause for animation again and won’t overlap with the combat lobby[/p][/*][*][p]Better layouts for users on 16:10 resolutions or similar[/p][/*][*][p]Behind the scenes tweaks to prevent some MacOS crashes[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]Gencon 2025[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560184/448f49d67c52d556f170dd620fcb12b66ae1c8d8.png"][/img][/p][p]We’re heading to GenCon2025 and we’re bringing the galaxy with us! ✨[/p][p]Join the [i]Once Upon a Galaxy[/i] crew live in Indianapolis, July 31 – August 3, for a weekend full of exclusive giveaways, live demos, developer meetups, and cosmic surprises.[/p][p]Whether you’re a seasoned space pirate or just picking up your first Captain, we’d love to meet you. Come say hi, play a few rounds, and snag some goodies you won’t find anywhere else![/p][p]We will be located between the Event Hall and the Exhibition Hall that has all the booths.[/p][hr][/hr][p]The stars are shining brightly upon [i]Once Upon a Galaxy[/i] and we are excited to share this journey with all of you![/p][p]Come let us know what you think of the patch changes in the [url="https://discord.gg/p7cuZQrmdX"]Discord[/url], on [url="https://x.com/PlayGalaxyGame"]Twitter[/url], [url="https://bsky.app/profile/playgalaxygame.bsky.social"]Bluesky[/url], [url="https://reddit.com/r/PlayGalaxy"]Reddit[/url] and [url="https://instagram.com/playgalaxygame"]Instagram[/url] or come join our weekly Dev [url="https://twitch.com/playgalaxygame"]Twitch[/url] Streams on Tuesdays at 2pm EST and be sure to leave us a review on Steam, Android and in the Apple App Store![/p]
